messages:
ava: Quick sketch dropped for the small-card latency view. Focus: keep p95 legible, support keyboard nav for heatmap, and decide sampling control + pin/sync affordances.
rui: Quick Q: presets only or presets + advanced slider?
ava: Proposal: presets (1%, 5%, 10%) with a "Custom" option that reveals a compact slider. Show a small "custom" badge when non-preset is active.
jamal: Backend note: cap slider min at 1%, default sample=5% for heavy heatmap queries. API param remains sample_rate; client maps label->param.
lisa: A11y: keep Canvas for perf but lazy-mount an offscreen DOM mirror when keyboard or SR detected. Mirror container role="grid"; each cell role="gridcell" with aria-label like "Bucket 3 of 12: 62 requests, p95 198 ms". Debounce announcements 250-300ms so SRs aren't spammed.
morgan: Pin behavior: default = per-user per-panel. Add a dashboard-level ephemeral "Sync ranges" toggle in the header for session sync; do not persist unless user explicitly saves. Visual: small filled pin plus dashed outline on pinned cards. Tooltip: "Pinned range (you)".
rui: For colorblind support, add an optional hatch/angle pattern for the top density bucket. Toggle lives in display settings. Make patterns accessible (SVG with role="img" and descriptive title) or mark decorative elements aria-hidden="true" and provide textual summary.
ava: Microcopy: legend -> "Latency (ms)"; tooltip short -> "p95: 214 ms"; keyboard focus/readout -> "95th percentile latency: 214 milliseconds"; sampling label -> "Data sample". On narrow widths abbreviate bucket labels ("<50") but keep unit in legend header; tooltip always includes units.
lisa: Scrubber aria example for the time range handle: role="slider" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100" aria-valuenow="45" aria-label="Time range start" aria-live="polite". Debounce live updates to ~200-300ms. Ensure focus halo meets contrast tokens.
design-bot: Mock uploaded -> https://redwood.app/figma/pin-sync-hatch-patterns.
ava: Thanks all
diving into updates now. I'll push a short spec + a11y checklist and we'll sync tomorrow 10:30am to review implementation tasks.
